Ranked defects and suggested fixes (none applied)

F1 · High — Sky ignores the Ardennes grey overcast intent
Dry, overcast and fog daytime frames all show a clear blue sky; overcast only washes the hills. The def/brief ask for grey zenith [0.42,0.48,0.52] and dense damp fog. js/circuits/scenery/spa.js:18 merges ATM.dampArdennes into pal and js/circuits/spa.js:34 sets a grey pal, but the rendered sky comes from the time-of-day/weather atmosphere path, not pal (suspected: js/lighting/atmosphere.js; not traced). Suggest: make the weather/ToD sky blend toward pal.zenith/horizon for circuits that declare a damp palette, or treat overcast as a sky-colour override.
F2 · High — Forest mass is far thinner than the brief
Orbit frames show isolated pines on wide mown verges (about 20–40 m of bare grass beside the asphalt) instead of 'walls of dark forest crowding the track'. The deep ranks (js/circuits/scenery/spa.js:725-730) are filtered by the OPEN windows (spa.js:670-702, which cover most of the left side 0–0.118 and many others), the 8% clearing roll (spa.js:714) and crownClear (spa.js:75-91, drops pines on slopes steeper than ~30%). Hilly terrain probably rejects most candidates. def dressingExclusions foliage 0–1 (js/circuits/spa.js:27) disables the engine foliage so only these bespoke belts exist. Suggest: log accepted vs rejected counts per rank and relax crownClear for the 28 m rank, or seat pines on terrainYAt rather than rejecting them.
F3 · Medium — Wet/rain/storm reflections draw mirrored props on grass
In wet, rain, storm and dusk-rain frames (02, 03, 06) upside-down trees, a camera tower and a post appear detached on the grass beside the road. The reflection pass seems to apply to all ground, not only the road. Engine/renderer scope (js/lighting or js/render wet reflection), not a circuit defect. Suggest: mask the reflection by road/kerb material or by a surface-wetness term.
F4 · Medium — No night lighting infrastructure
night:false and furniture lamp:'none' (js/circuits/spa.js:21,45). At night the ground is lit only by headlights and a yellow glow pool with visible terrain facets; the pit building, stands and Gold 3 jumbotron show no lights. Expected per the survey-track note (night scenery is authored only on night:true circuits), but 'night' is selectable on Spa. Suggest: lit pit building, stand fascias and the jumbotron screens on dusk/night; or hide night for circuits without lamps.
F5 · Medium — Constant 16 m road width
Built hw is 8 m at all 100 profile samples (baseHW:8, no width zones, js/circuits/spa.js:20); wallStats minB 9.1 m. Real Spa varies roughly 12–18 m (source claim, not measured here). La Source and the Bus Stop read the same width as Kemmel. Suggest: width zones for T1, Raidillon and the Bus Stop.
F6 · Low — Eau Rouge left flick is not a numbered turn
Curvature shows L at 0.131 / R at 0.145 / L at 0.162, but turns[] (js/circuits/spa.js:47) has 0.1430 and 0.1615 only, so the Eau Rouge left (0.131) is unnumbered and T2 labels the Raidillon right. Real numbering is T2 = Eau Rouge left, T3 = Raidillon right (source claim). The a.corners() hook returns 42 entries against 20 curated turns.
F7 · Low — Required landmarks not registered
Spa has required modelGroups (spa-raidillon-gold-dual-jumbotron spa.js:255, spa-eau-rouge-brook-crossing :338, spa-timing-tower :525, footbridges via overheadSpan :556) but tests/data/landmarks/spa.json does not exist (51 landmark files for 52 circuits). AGENTS in js/circuits/ asks for one per circuit.
F8 · Low — Stray props near the road
Dry-day frames show a small orange cube on grass left of the start straight (01), a black slab beside the track at Kemmel (04), and a white plate at the kerb (trackside 03). Source not traced (candidates: random-side marshalPost spa.js:308-311, signs). Not confirmed as floating: ground/float audits pass.
F9 · Low — Spectator hills read as stacked planks
The grass spectator bank at ~0.50 (spectatorHill spa.js:597) shows as bare timber-brown tiers with no visible crowd at orbit distance.
F10 · Low — Built length 0.8% short
Built 6947.7 m vs 7004 m real (info.lengthErrorPct −0.7); path.len source metadata is 6979.

Filename pattern spa-<nn>-<view>-<tod>-<weather>.png (time of day before weather, as the gallery parser expects). Frames are downscaled to 800 px JPEG here; full PNGs are in artifacts/shots/tracks/spa/. Orbit camera, default distance 45 m, assist racing-line arrows visible.

orbit · day · dry

Baseline. Sky is clear blue; brief intends grey damp overcast (finding F1). Forest mass sparse (F2). Small stray props: orange cube left of the start straight (01), black slab right of the track (04).

orbit · day · wet

Road darkens/greys. Mirrored tree and ladder reflections appear on grass off the road (02, 06) (F3).

orbit · day · rain

Same reflection artefacts; vertical dark streak by the left verge (03). Day rain reads dim and green-grey rather than night-black, so the day/wet lighting merge works.

orbit · day · overcast

Overcast leaves the sky blue and only washes the hills; no grey ceiling (F1).

orbit · day · fog

Fog thickens in the hollows and bleaches the far ridges; sky above the fog stays blue (F1). Good depth response.

orbit · day · storm

Dark, desaturated, rain streaks. Reflections of props appear on grass (02,06). Storm at day is not night-dark.

orbit · dusk · dry

Dusk dry is not in this set (cut); see dusk rain.

orbit · dusk · rain

Bronze horizon, wet specular on tarmac. Reflection ghosts persist off-road (02,06). No lamps lit.

orbit · night · dry

Black sky; only the car headlights and a yellow glow pool light the ground. No lamp masts or lit stands (F4); terrain facets visible inside the pools.

orbit · night · rain

Headlight cones read well on wet tarmac; distant stands/props are black.

eye · day · dry

Driver-eye view. Verge props and kerb read at scale; the road surface noise texture is acceptable.

eye · day · storm

Eye-level storm: grass and road read as one reflective sheet; mirrored pine and mast reflections stand on the grass (F3).

eye · night · dry

Eye-level night.

trackside · day · dry

Trackside free-cam. White board plate sits at the kerb on 03; the red post and mast at 01 are the start-gantry legs/lamp.
